title: Make the Line Move
intro: One repeated note is a drone, not a bassline. Click an empty bass step to place and focus a note, then use the ↑ and ↓ arrow keys to move it in semitones (hold shift for whole octaves). Keep at least three notes lit and give them three different pitches — try leaving the first note low as an anchor and lifting the ones after it. Clicking a lit note clears it.
